speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) of prematurity. The infant's 33 weeks gestational age and onset of distress within two hours of birth are classic indicators; the ABG confirms respiratory acidosis consistent with surfactant deficiency.
